name: io.github.frenchleg/saas-pricing
title: SaaS Pricing
description: Current list prices, plans, limits and SSO/feature tiers for 50 popular SaaS tools, in USD and GBP.

tools.name: list_products
tools.description: List the SaaS products this server has pricing for, with starting paid price. Categories: accounting, ai, automation, communication, crm, database, design, dev-tools, ecommerce, hosting, marketing, productivity, project-management, scheduling, security, storage, support, video-audio, website-builder.

tools.name: get_pricing
tools.description: Full current pricing for one SaaS product: every plan with monthly and annual prices, pricing unit (per user, flat, usage), limits, key features, free tier/trial, source URL and last-checked date.

product.description: Product name or id, e.g. 'Notion', 'slack', 'Google Workspace', 'M365'.

currency.description: Currency for prices. Defaults to the vendor's own currency. GBP uses official UK prices where published, otherwise converts at the live ECB rate.

tools.name: search_plans
tools.description: Search across all products for plans that include a feature (e.g. 'SSO', 'SCIM', 'audit log', 'HIPAA', 'API') and/or cost at most max_price per unit per month. Results sorted by price, cheapest first.

feature.description: Feature keyword. 'sso' matches any single sign-on incl. Google SSO; use 'saml' for enterprise SAML SSO only. Also: 'scim', 'audit log', 'hipaa', 'api'.

max_price.description: Maximum price per unit (user/seat or flat) per month, in the chosen currency.

currency.description: Currency for prices. Defaults to the vendor's own currency. GBP uses official UK prices where published, otherwise converts at the live ECB rate.

billing.description: Billing period. 'annual' gives the per-month equivalent when billed yearly. Default monthly.

tools.name: compare_products
tools.description: Compare 2-8 SaaS products for a given team size: per-plan monthly and annual totals, applying per-seat pricing and seat minimums, plus the cheapest paid plan for each.

billing.description: Billing period. 'annual' gives the per-month equivalent when billed yearly. Default monthly.

currency.description: Currency for prices. Defaults to the vendor's own currency. GBP uses official UK prices where published, otherwise converts at the live ECB rate.

tools.name: report_outdated
tools.description: Flag a price, plan or feature in this dataset that looks wrong or out of date, or request a product that isn't covered. Reports are reviewed by the maintainer.

product.description: Product name or id (can be a product not yet covered).

details.description: What is wrong, e.g. 'Pro is now $12/user/month billed monthly per vendor page'.
